name: Pradeux
description: The Pradeux was an Imperial-class Star Destroyer that was a part of the navy of the Galactic Empire. Manufactured by Kuat Drive Yards and measuring 1,600 meters in length, it had a bridge that was outfitted with a communications tower and at least one ISD-72x deflector shield generator dome.
